messages.subject: Plot background color
parts:
I am using the 0.9 ggplot2 and have 2 quick questions (I tried to make
them as simple as possible):

1) I am trying to set the plot background and the following (that I
found on the web) does not work:
qplot(x=1:3,y=1:3)+opts(plot.background=theme_rect(fill="green",colour="red"))

2) On a similar note, if I copy a theme and edit it, I get the
complaint that the unit() function is not found. I am guessing it is
in a package I have not loaded or that perhaps unit() was not made
visible in the current version of gplot2 (I have updated all packages).

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: Plot background color
parts:
I am using the 0.9 ggplot2 and have 2 quick questions (I tried to make
them as simple as possible):

1) I am trying to set the plot background and the following (that I
found on the web) does not work:
qplot(x=1:3,y=1:3)+opts(plot.background=theme_rect(fill="green",colour="red"))

Are you looking for panel.background?

qplot(x=1:3,y=1:3) + opts(panel.background=theme_rect(fill="green",colour="red"))

2) On a similar note, if I copy a theme and edit it, I get the
complaint that the unit() function is not found. I am guessing it is
in a package I have not loaded or that perhaps unit() was not made
visible in the current version of gplot2 (I have updated all packages).

You need to load the grid package : library(grid).

Cheers
david
